findings: Photo-informed circular side covers, stepped casting, plate and control-side layout retained from version 18.
Tilt drag is on the photographed cover side; pan lock is at the opposite front corner; rear counterbalance, readouts and side lock are recognizable and selectable.
Labels read correctly in front, side and rear inspection presets. Compact windows use the text inspector and zoom for small labels.
Short-window inspector obstruction found during visual review was corrected; the control selector and scrollable inspector are reachable at 320x256.
